project_identity.name: Cactus Ed's Happiest Place (CEHP)
project_identity.concept: You play Ed, a cigarette-smoking cactus navigating surreal institutional worlds (orientation bureau, school, medical pavilion). Bureaucratic-absurdist satire. The game silently tracks your playstyle across 6 behavioral axes and generates a personalized 'receipt' that reveals how the institution interpreted your behavior.
project_identity.seven_word_version: Ed is calm. The world is not.
project_identity.rendering: Procedural canvas draw calls (fillRect/fillCircle). No sprite sheets.
project_identity.current_state: All 10 GOAT rounds shipped. Corrupted Broadcast visual evolution shipped 2026-03-21. 4 playable scenes. 19,835-line index.html. 3-5 minute total playtime.
project_identity.direction: REBUILD — fresh architecture, honor the creative bloodline, keep the crown jewels, rethink the code structure.

tech_stack.runtime: Phaser 3 via CDN, ES5 JavaScript only, HTML5 Canvas, Web Audio API, localStorage
tech_stack.tooling: Playwright smoke tests, Node verification scripts, GitHub Pages deploy

sacred_constraints_do_not_violate: Single HTML file — no build step, no bundler, no npm run to play
ES5 JavaScript only (no ES6 modules, no arrow functions in hot paths)
The cigarette is central to Ed's identity — weapon, helicopter (cig-copter), health indicator
Save compatibility (cactusEd_save_v1) — never break silently, migrate or version-bump
Institutional satire tone must remain consistent — Ed stays calm, world stays off
Behavioral tracking stays silent — no visible axis meters during play; the receipt is the reveal
Browser-playable — if it can't run from a URL, it doesn't ship

creative_bloodline.universe: Counterfeit Educational Universe — the game world is a forgery of educational broadcast. Authentic-looking but slightly off. Signs contradict themselves. Lanyards are suspicious.
ed_voice_rules: Ed is calm. The world is not. The tension is everything.

characters.cats: Philosophers. Not cute. They speak in paradoxes. They know things.
characters.rasta_corp: Sincere. Not the joke. The only honest institution.
characters.institutional_enemies: Safety cones, hall monitors, scantrons, pencils, pills, insurance adjusters. Sincere in their corruption.

no_list: No predatory retention (no FOMO timers, no loot boxes, no punishing streaks)
No breaking character (institutional voice never winks at player)
No tutorial pop-ups that contradict the world's tone

1_behavioral_tracking.description: Silent 6-axis playstyle tracker: compliance, intuition, curiosity, grace, chaos, efficiency.
1_behavioral_tracking.why_its_the_moat: No other platformer does this. Players don't see axes → organic discovery. Receipts feel personal. Shareability. Replay incentive.

2_procedural_receipts.description: End-of-world personalized summary generated from ~60 unique flavor texts across 6 axes. Mad-libs style.
2_procedural_receipts.example_grace: NEAR-MISS COMMENDATION: You avoided harm at the last moment. Harm felt ignored.
2_procedural_receipts.example_chaos: DISRUPTION REPORT: You solved a problem by breaking it. The problem has been archived as resolved.
2_procedural_receipts.example_curiosity: UNSCHEDULED INQUIRY: You looked behind the sign. The sign has been coached to feel betrayed.

3_case_seed_system.description: Every run gets a deterministic identifier: CASE-YYYYMMDD-RUN-AXIS (e.g. CASE-20260420-007-CURIOSITY). Shareable. Replayable.

4_corrupted_broadcast_aesthetic.description: Game looks like a corrupted institutional TV broadcast. Scanlines, CRT rolls, chromatic aberration, per-axis color grading (compliance=sterile blue, chaos=magenta bleed, grace=warm amber). Signal glitches.
4_corrupted_broadcast_aesthetic.why_it_works: Programmer-art canvas calls stop reading as 'prototype' and start reading as 'intentional lo-fi broadcast.' Biggest perceptual leap in the project.

5_movement_engine.quality: Celeste-tier. This is the game's strongest asset.
5_movement_engine.note_on_drift: DO_NOT_BREAK.md lists OLDER/DRIFTED constants (walkSpeed 140, jumpVel -520) from 2026-03-09. The live-tuned values above are what players have been validating. Port the live values, not the drifted doctrine ones.

6_procedural_everything.art: All canvas draw calls (fillRect, fillCircle). 916 draw calls in current index.html.
6_procedural_everything.audio: Web Audio oscillators + filters, no samples.

what_to_rethink_in_rebuild: Code architecture: 19,835 lines in one file. ES5 + single-file is sacred, but use IIFE modules or explicit section headers for internal structure.
World length: current worlds are 60-90s each. Expand to 3-5 min each without breaking receipt cadence.
Progressive ability introduction: Ed starts with 2 actions, institution 'trains' him into the other 11. Diegetic teaching.
Audio depth: procedural music (Web Audio oscillator-based ambient responding to behavioral state). Never audio files.
Content templates (Round 10): double down. A new world should take 1 focused sprint.
UX polish: wall-of-text controls screen → diegetic in-world teaching. Death → a tiny institutional form getting stamped.
Save schema v2: if new fields arrive, bump to cactusEd_save_v2 with explicit v1→v2 migration.
what_to_retire: Empty asset scaffolds: ACTIVE/game/art, audio, content, ui (if assets stay procedural)
Pre-2026-03-20 changelog ALL/ path references (historical, leave as-is, don't retroactively update)

kevin_collaboration_rules.match_his_energy: When he's fired up, be fired up. When he's focused, be focused.

code_style: No emoji in UIs — use lucide-react icons where UI exists (but CEHP is canvas, so mostly N/A)
No unnecessary refactoring of unrelated code
Tests expected — 300-800+ tests in his other projects (CEHP has Playwright smoke tests)
No magic numbers — use named constants
kevin_collaboration_rules.simulation_determinism: If any sim/RNG code: seeded RNG only, NO Math.random(). Deterministic from Case Seed.

patterns_to_watch: Canvas focus loss — clicking outside canvas steals input. Fix: explicit focus-return + key release on blur.
Text overlap — multiple HUD strings at same coords. Fix: z-layer discipline + coord reservations.
Camera snap on scene transitions — use smooth interpolation.
Stale progress — atomic save writes, debounced 250ms.
Query-param bleed (?start=w3 persisting in prod) — sanitize on load.
